review_method: Inspect code paths and named positive/negative assertions against each invariant, exact source provenance and declared platform evidence.
procedure: Run fixed synthetic CLI and source-linked assertion suite; inspect version/media traces, wire call counts, hash/identity and normalized reports. Review historical evidence separately, expected-failure boundary and downstream repair obligations.
expected: Separate historical observed execution success and terminal rename conflict without claiming original cause.
observed: All11 bounded synthetic schedules inspected; every case executes exactly once with valid original exit0/result evidence. Benign/stale version mismatch strands same generation before any terminal wire write; fresh foreign generation is STALE; post-precheck foreign generation exposes unsafe success; media delay/lost reply controls recover. Windows868 pass+2 skip+1 strict expected failure; Linux1285+2+1; ledger/scanner/source review pass. Historical cause UNKNOWN, DEF-001 OPEN.
platform_scope: Isolated Windows synthetic development and Linux CI; no live Google request/process, native package changes or prior workload replay.
unverified_scope: No original matching provider trace or independently verified installed binary; cannot prove historical cause. No R2 atomic authority implementation/repair or live runtime acceptance. Strict xfail remains unresolved handoff, not a passing feature.
rollback: Synthetic fixtures/docs only; preserve original live result and historical evidence, no clear/rename/replay.
